builder_report.summary: Stage a is built, tested and measured (no threads, no timing); protected files untouched, nothing pushed. Client: stage_clients/speculative.rs (a StageLinearSystem wrapper plus a recording RHS wrapper; modes Exact, G8, G7, LaggedOneStep). Exact is bit-identical to the protected dense driver; call k after factor is stage k+1 (bitwise); zero allocations per step. On 33 adaptive cells (11 stiff problems x 3 rtol) G8/G7 pass the step criterion (median 1.000/1.000, max 1.039/1.044, no cell above 1.10, no KILL) and the order criterion (4.862/4.842 and 4.977/4.964 against exact 4.863 and 4.976; the three stiff order problems are non-discriminating because the exact arm itself reaches only 2.0-3.3). Both FAIL the error-ratio criterion in the per-cell reading I predeclared (G8 3 cells, all e5; G7 6 cells; median ratios 1.000/0.982), so both mode verdicts are FAIL. Caveat: the protected method rerun with rtol x1.02 or /1.02 fails the same rule in 6 and 5 cells, and on e5 its own end-point error is 430 to 31550 tolerance units, so this criterion does not isolate the Jacobian. A Jacobian lagged one full step (exploratory) breaks as theory S4 predicts: step ratio median 3.02, max 11.3, order 3.02.

open_issues: Owner ruling needed on the error-ratio criterion: the frozen row names no aggregate; I predeclared the per-cell reading and both modes fail it, but so does the protected method against itself under a 2 percent tolerance change, so the failure cannot be attributed to the speculative Jacobian and the criterion as read does not show it is harmless either. I did not re-read the threshold.

e5 (t_end 1e13, atol 1.7e-24): the protected RODAS5P misses its tolerance by 430 to 31550 times at the end point. Cause not investigated; the linear invariant y3 - y2 + y4 drifts by 1e-19 to 1.5e-21, the size of the error, which points to floating-point drift in ill-conditioned solves (unverified).

Order evidence rests on two non-stiff problems; on the three stiff ones, including both Prothero-Robinson types, the protected method's own observed order is 2.0 to 3.3, so the 4.8 threshold could not discriminate there.

One cell per mode (oregonator, rtol 1e-8) is not decidable because the predeclared uncertainty takes the larger of two Julia runs and RadauIIA5 is far less accurate than requested; without it the cell passes (exploratory).

Stage b was not built. It additionally needs: G7 rather than G8, a step-size prediction before any factorization can overlap (otherwise only the Jacobian evaluation overlaps), a signal when g7 is ready, discarding of work from rejected attempts (protected rejection rate 0 to 39 percent per cell), a second Jacobian buffer, a concurrency contract for user callbacks, and V04's regime condition. Step-size hit rate was not measured.
Scope: n <= 200, dense storage, analytic Jacobians only; banded or sparse inner clients and finite-difference Jacobians were not measured.
The client is reachable only as rodas5p_integrators::stage_clients::speculative::*; no re-export was added because stage_clients/mod.rs is protected.
rulings: Error-ratio criterion read strictly per cell (every valid cell in [0.67, 1.5]); a cell whose interval under the reference uncertainty straddles a bound is not decidable; declared before any run.

Order fit range fixed by a rule applied to the exact arm only (largest h downward until its error drops below 1e-11, then the six smallest h); a problem whose exact arm is below 4.8 is reported and non-discriminating.

Constant steps enforced with initial_step = max_step = h (all dyadic, h = 1.5/N) and rtol = atol = 1e10, verified per run (accepted = N, no rejection, smallest and largest accepted step equal h bit for bit).
Reference value SciPy Radau rtol 1e-13; uncertainty |ref - Radau 1e-11| + max(|ref - Julia RadauIIA5|, |ref - Julia Rodas5P|); closed forms for pr-nonlinear and the order set.

Exact Jacobian is used at the first linearization, at the retry after an error-type failure (recognised by an unchanged linearization time) and when no complete recorded attempt ends at the linearization time; after a local-error rejection the driver keeps the linearization, so the speculative Jacobian is kept.

The speculative Jacobian uses the recorded stage time t_n + c_i h, which is the accepted time bit for bit (c_7 = c_8 = 1, checked); the time derivative and f(t, y) are evaluated by the driver at the accepted state and are exact in every mode.

The trait was sufficient: no separate research driver. Because OdeProblem keeps its callbacks private and problem.rs is protected, the recording wrapper is applied to the right-hand-side callback before the problem is built.
HIRES, Oregonator and Brusselator N=32 are used as development problems and are not called holdout.

Deviations from the predeclaration are listed in REPORT_KO.md section 7 (protected arm's accepted steps read from controller telemetry in the fixed-step runs; exploratory details fixed after the measurement; contract tests run between predeclaration and measurement).

review.summary: accept_with_corrections. Scope, protection and commit order are clean: 27 changed paths, all allowed; protected blobs equal the base; PREDECLARED.json is the first commit, its blob never changed, and the first build artifact of the node's tests is 16 minutes younger. Re-run here: 4 node test targets (17 + 1 pass), sentinels, client kit, clippy, rustfmt, loop checker; the 3 measurement programs (348/482/50 record lines byte-identical to the committed logs); both reference scripts (33 SciPy and 22 Julia records identical). reference.json, RESULTS.json and REPORT_KO.md regenerate identically from the raw logs. My own recomputation gives the builder's verdicts: G8 step PASS (median 1, max 161/155), error FAIL (29/3/1 cells), order PASS (4.862, 4.977); G7 step PASS (max 47/45), no KILL, error FAIL (26/6/1), order PASS (4.842, 4.964). Exact mode equals the protected driver in 33 + 80 runs. Corrections concern the record, not the code: G8 fails on e5 only, where the error is round-off drift, and without e5 it is NOT_DECIDABLE, not PASS; the order PASS depends on the pre-declared fit window; frozen text and pre-declared readings must be recorded apart.

findings.claim: G8 fails the error-ratio criterion in 3 cells, all e5; G8 stage a verdict FAIL.
findings.evidence: Reproduced: 29 PASS / 3 FAIL / 1 NOT_DECIDABLE, failing ratios 0.1055, 1.8479, 0.1354 (e5 at rtol 1e-4, 1e-6, 1e-8). On e5 the protected arm ends at y = (3.66e-46, -6.82e-33, 1.079e-19, 3.84e-61) for rtol 1e-4 while the reference is (about 0, 8.837e-23, 8.885e-23, about 0). Its error (31546 tolerance units; 3360 and 430 at the tighter tolerances) equals the residual of the linear invariant y3 - y2 + y4 (1.08e-19), so these cells compare round-off drift. The 1.02 tolerance-jitter controls of the protected method fail 5 of their 6 e5 cells. The ratios do not move when literature end values replace the builder's reference (they differ by 3.0e-25, inside the stated uncertainty). The same pre-declared rule on the 30 cells without e5 gives 29 PASS + 1 NOT_DECIDABLE (oregonator rtol 1e-8: e_prot 0.167, U 0.157, U set by Julia RadauIIA5), so the criterion would be NOT_DECIDABLE, not PASS. G7 without e5 keeps 3 FAIL cells.
findings.correction: Record G8 as FAIL under the pre-declared every-cell reading, with the note that the failure carries no information about J(g8). A ruling that sets e5 aside does not make G8 pass: the reference-uncertainty rule (run B) must be ruled on as well, or that cell re-referenced. This FAIL should not be used as a kill of the lever.

findings.claim: Order criterion PASS: G8 4.862 / 4.977 and G7 4.842 / 4.964 against exact 4.863 / 4.976.
findings.evidence: Reproduced with the pre-declared rule (kaps-eps1 N = 12..64, logistic-pair N = 16..96). The margin over 4.8 on kaps-eps1 is 0.062 (G8) and 0.042 (G7) because the protected method itself is pre-asymptotic there (4.863). With all 8 contiguous points (N = 6..64) the slopes are exact 4.811, G8 4.807, G7 4.769. The raw errors show no loss: the G7 error is at or below the exact error at every N of the window (8.09e-8 against 8.45e-8 at N = 12, 2.46e-11 against 2.47e-11 at N = 64). pr-nonlinear is non-discriminating only because the pre-declared window lies on its error floor (3.28); on N = 6..32 the slopes are exact 5.955, G8 5.957, G7 5.978. The lagged arm (3.02, 3.63) shows the test can detect a Jacobian error.
findings.correction: Keep PASS. Record that it holds for the pre-declared fit window and that 3 of 5 order problems are excluded by the pre-declared discriminating rule.

findings.claim: Report rows give as frozen threshold '>= 4.8 on problems where the exact arm reaches 4.8' and 'within [0.67, 1.5] (every cell)'; the G7 kill rule is given the verdict PASS.
findings.evidence: PREREGISTRATION.md row V07 and the contract entry say only: step ratio <= 1.02 median and <= 1.05 max, error ratio in [0.67, 1.5], observed order >= 4.8, KILL any step ratio > 1.10 with g7. build_results.py uses exactly 102/100, 105/100, 110/100, (0.67, 1.5) and 4.8. Three readings are the builder's: step ratio = attempts ratio at equal tolerance, error ratio = end-point WRMS ratio in every cell, order only on problems where the exact arm reaches 4.8. All three are in PREDECLARED.json (blob 37dd6266, unchanged since commit 16cd264d). No threshold was moved and no adaptive cell was excluded (33 of 33 valid, no failed arm).

findings.claim: The error-ratio failures cannot be attributed to the speculative Jacobian because the protected method fails the same rule under a 2 percent tolerance change.
findings.evidence: Controls reproduced: 6 and 5 failing cells, range 0.534 to 3.116. The statement holds for the set, but G7 is not inside the control cell by cell: it deviates more than both controls in 10 of 33 cells (G8 in 5), its median |ln ratio| is 0.063 against 0.040 for the controls (G8 0.012), and in nldiff-100 at rtol 1e-6 it takes 165 instead of 174 attempts with an error ratio of 1.5142 (controls 1.178 and 0.893). My own DOP853 reference for that problem differs 1.8e-13 from the builder's and gives 1.514222. Exploratory matched-error step ratios reach 1.096 for G8 (hires, rtol 1e-6) and 1.073 for G7 (pollution, rtol 1e-4), both above 1.05.
findings.correction: Word the record as 'the criterion does not isolate the Jacobian', not as 'no effect'; for G7 mention the larger spread and the matched-error maxima, labelled exploratory.

findings.claim: On e5 the protected method's end-point error is 430 to 31550 tolerance units.

findings.claim: CONFIRMED: Exact mode identity, stage mapping, accepted-attempt rule, reference independence, fit rule and kill rule.
findings.evidence: Identity: the tests compare integrate_rodas5p_fast_observed_with_atol on the plain problem with the client driver in mode Exact (attempts, every counter, 11 output states, linearization points; in-place and faer LU; rejections exercised). Mapping: a mirror of Workspace::attempt reproduces the accepted state bit for bit and call k after factor equals the argument of stage k+1 bit for bit; an independent k-form step agrees to 1.3e-15 with gaps of at least 9.5e-8 between g7, g8 and the new state. Rejection: the driver calls linearize only on a fresh state, so the retry after a local-error rejection keeps the Jacobian of the last accepted attempt. In all 132 client runs linearizations = accepted steps = Jacobian builds and reuses = rejections (1501 rejected attempts in the G8 and G7 runs); the retry after an error-type failure uses the exact Jacobian (9 trap cases in the test); exact_no_point is 0 in every run. Reference: SciPy Radau 1e-13 for the value, uncertainty from Radau 1e-11, Julia RadauIIA5 and Rodas5P; the closed forms recomputed with mpmath are bit-equal. The fixed-step fit uses the pre-declared window and all 400 fixed-step runs pass the pre-declared constant-step check. The kill rule is an integer comparison over all 33 cells.
